:::{#cor-cosine-similarity-unit-vectors}
#### Cosine similarity of unit vectors is their inner product

In a real inner product space (@def-inner-product-space), if $\norm{\vx} = \norm{\vy} = 1$, then

$$
\cossim(\vx, \vy) = \iprod{\vx}{\vy}.
$$

:::

::: proof

Both norms in the denominator of @def-cosine-similarity-inner-product-space equal $1$, so

$$
\cossim(\vx, \vy) = \frac{\iprod{\vx}{\vy}}{1 \cd 1} = \iprod{\vx}{\vy}.
$$

:::
